alt: Line chart of traditional public school enrollment in millions, fall 2010 through fall 2021, holding near 47 million through 2019 and falling to about 45.4 million in 2020 and 2021.
chartSummary: Traditional public school enrollment stayed close to 47 million from fall 2010 to fall 2019, then dropped to about 45.4 million in fall 2020 and 2021. This crop shows only the top of Figure 4, whose caption covers enrollment by school type; the lower series are outside the visible area.
